name: Speakeasy
description: Text-to-speech that reads page content aloud using the browser's Speech Synthesis API, with a configurable block, global settings, and per-user voice/speed preferences.
project_description:
Speakeasy adds accessible text-to-speech controls powered by the browser's Speech Synthesis API so visitors can listen to your site content, complete with keyboard shortcuts for quick playback control.

Features

Flexible playback UI. Place the Speakeasy block to compile plain text from the node fields your audience can view, then present it as a button set, media player, or simple link with optional voice picker, custom labels, and per-block speed overrides. The block only renders when content is available and passes everything to Drupal behaviors for playback.

Sentence highlighting and auto-scroll. Enable highlighting to attach an additional library that wraps each sentence, tracks playback progress, and scrolls the page as the words are spoken.

Curate the voice list. Administrators pick the default theme, toggle voice selection and highlighting globally, set the default rate, whitelist voices per browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, other), and restrict languages from a single settings form. The front-end voice loader enforces those limits while matching the visitor's locale and saved preferences.

Theme-ready styling. Choose between the bundled Default and Olivero-inspired themes or opt out entirely (None) to supply your own CSS.

Visitor preferences. Grant users a self-service form at /user/speakeasy/preferences to save their preferred voice and speed, stored in the user.data store and honored whenever the block renders.

Usability extras. The front-end announces when speech synthesis is unavailable, updates ARIA state in real time, and offers keyboard shortcuts (Space to play/pause, S to stop).

Getting started

Configure global defaults at Configuration > Speakeasy to choose the theme, voice/highlighting policies, default speed, and any per-browser or language filters. Place the Speakeasy block, pick an output style and the text fields to read, and set per-block options. Allow users with the appropriate permission to save their own voice and speed.

Permissions

Administer Speakeasy settings manages the global configuration page. Manage Speakeasy user preferences opens the personal preferences form, linked from the user account menu.

Browser support

Speakeasy relies on the browser's Speech Synthesis API. Voice availability and quality vary by browser and operating system; Windows with Chrome or Edge typically offers the most voices. The module alerts visitors whose browser does not support the API.
